in_hebrew.name: Almena
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Noble, Exalted One
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Almena הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'alma,' meaning 'noble' or 'exalted.' In ancient Greek culture, 'Alma' was a name given to women of high social standing or extraordinary beauty. In Christian tradition, Almena is often associated with the Virgin Mary and her divine motherhood.

in_latin.name: Almena
in_latin.long_meaning: Almena is a Latin name derived from 'almenus', which means 'grief' or 'sorrow'. This name has its roots in ancient Roman culture and was likely used to describe someone who has experienced great loss or heartache. In early Christian tradition, the name may have been used to symbolize the emotional pain and suffering associated with following Christ.
